jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Platform
jobs.content:
Build resilient Python data pipelines for analytics and product teams.

You will own Airflow orchestration, dbt transformations, Snowflake modeling, and AWS data infrastructure.

Lead platform reliability improvements and cost optimization for batch workflows.
